FULL TEXT:
Doon University, Dehradun
WALK-IN INTERVIEW FOR THE POST OF PROJECT ASSISTANT
Applications are invited from eligible candidates for engagement as Project Assistant for the research
project entitled “Classroom to Community Advanced Technologies and Education for Renewable
Energy and Climate Change in Uttarakhand through Samvaad, Sanyojan and Abhyaas”, funded by
NCSTC, Department of Science and Technology (DST), in the School of Physical Sciences, Doon
University, Dehradun.
S. No. Position No. of Posts Minimum Eligibility
1 Project Assistant 01 First class Master degree in Chemistry (M.Sc.).
CSIR/UGC-NET/JRF or GATE Qualified in Chemistry
Details are given below-
1. Positions: Project Assistant-01 post
For General and OBC Category: Minimum 60% aggregate mark in the qualifying examination
is essential.
For SC/ST/Physically Handicapped Category: Minimum 55% aggregate marks in qualifying
examination is essential.
2. Emoluments: 1) Fellowship
Rs. 37000/- per month or as per OM and the qualification of the candidate.
Further, in addition to this, it is to be mentioned here that any other allowance like HRA, Medical, etc.
will not be paid to the Project Assistant.
3. Qualifications & Experience
a) PG Degree (M.Sc.) in Chemistry with 60% marks or CGPA of 6.5 or above
b) Candidate should have a valid GATE/CSIR-UGC NET qualification score.
Walk-in Interview Schedule
Date 30 November 2026
Reporting Time 10:00 AM
Interview 11:00 AM onwards
Venue Composite Lab Building, Physics/Chemistry Office, Doon University, Dehradun
Note: Candidates possessing the minimum eligibility of M.Sc. in Chemistry are invited to attend the
walk-in interview. Candidates should report at the venue by 10:00 AM.
